subtitulo: Allocate what was produced in this batch among the orders that make it up, and generate the sales delivery notes.
sin_tanda_aviso: This screen needs a batch — access it from "Close and allocate" in Today's production.
nada_que_repartir: There is nothing pending to allocate in this batch — it may already be fully delivered, or there may not be any closed production yet.
supera_disponible_aviso: Exceeds what's available — adjust before confirming.
lineas_libres_titulo: Free-text lines (other / service) inherited by the allocation
